Try itStep 2, fewer arrows: one superstate arrow replaces five

  • Goal: add an emergency stop without an arrow from every state.
  • The AV must be able to stop from any of its five behaviors, so one flat FSM needs 5 arrows to Emergency stop.

try it
  • 1The superstate Driving holds the five behaviors.
  • 2One arrow leaves Driving for Emergency stop. It stands for 5 arrows, one from each state inside.
Harel lets a transition that leaves a superstate stand for that transition leaving every state inside it: “the main way statecharts economize in the number of arrows” (Harel, 1987).
